profile.subject: a cream golden retriever dog
profile.styleHints: Creamy white long fur, floppy ears, black nose, pink tongue, feathery tail

cycle.prompt: Same cream golden retriever dog with long white fur and floppy ears in strict side profile facing right, one eye visible, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps: happy walking gait cycle, legs alternating, feathery tail wagging slightly, tongue out

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: Standing in side view facing right, head up, mouth open with pink tongue out, feathery tail relaxed, calm stance.

rest.label: Sit
rest.prompt: Pose: Sitting upright with straight front paws, hind legs folded, tail curled around side, tongue out panting gently.

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.prompt: Pose: Lying curled on side with paws tucked together, eyes closed, head resting on paws, fluffy tail over nose.

voice.label: Bark
voice.prompt: Pose: Standing alert facing right, mouth wide open barking, ears perked, fluffy tail wagging high.

trick.label: Give Paw
trick.prompt: Pose: Sitting and lifting one front paw up high, head tilted, mouth open smiling, fluffy tail wagging.

lines: Hi I am Pakkun, let's play!
I love you so so much!
Wag wag, I am so happy!

facts.text: English Cream is just their light coat color, not a separate breed.
They are friendly, gentle, smart dogs who love families.
They love to swim, hike, and play a fun game of fetch.
